story: Varda was started by Will Bruey, a SpaceX veteran, and Delian Asparouhov of Founders Fund, where the company was incubated. It raised a $9M seed in December 2020 and a $42M Series A seven months later to build a three-part spacecraft: a bought-in satellite bus (Rocket Lab Photon), a manufacturing module and its own re-entry capsule. differentiator: First commercial company to land a capsule on US soil; treats re-entry as a routine logistics service rather than a one-off mission.

story: Xona was founded in 2019 by five co-founders led by Brian Manning to build a privately run navigation constellation in low Earth orbit as an alternative and complement to GPS. differentiator: First private company to fly a navigation satellite in LEO; stronger signals than GNSS from medium Earth orbit, with authentication built in.
